item.title: “I Am Jesus Christ”: 57 Funny Things People Said Under Anesthesia
item.description: It can be quite a trip to be on anesthesia. Not only does it make a potentially agonizing procedure a lot more bearable, but it also puts you in an altered state of consciousness that can lead to comedic moments. Here are some of the funniest things people said while medicated, according to doctors and the patients themselves.

item.title: If You’ve Ever Misbehaved At A Work Function, You’re Not Alone And Here Are 63 Wild Stories To Prove It
item.description: HR manager grabs the mic, and starts spitting the names of workers sleeping with each other. Employee punches her manager and a company executive before driving her car into a lake. Head of Sales dances topless on the table in front of everyone... No, it's not "The Hangover" meets "The Office." These are real office party scandals that people witnessed with their own eyes.

item.title: “He Wasn’t Telling Me The Full Truth”: 38 Times Women Ignored Their Gut Feelings While Dating
item.description: Hindsight is always 20/20. We have to make decisions every single day, so inevitably, we're going to wish that we had made different ones from time to time. But it can sting even more when you realize that you had made the wrong choice by ignoring what your gut was telling you. Women have been opening up about times they pushed their instincts aside when dating, so here's a list of stories that will remind you to always trust your intuition over anything else.

item.title: 100 Historical And Modern Photos That Reveal How New York Has Changed
item.description: New York City is the sort of place most people might feel familiar with even if they’ve never been there since it shows up in everything from TV shows to songs. So we’ve gathered some fascinating before and after pictures to show just how the Big Apple has changed over the years.

item.title: Woman Asks Why Girls They Don’t Get Their Nails Done, And These 86 Savage Replies Didn’t Disappoint
item.description: A woman innocently asked other girls online why they don't get manicures and pedicures. While she probably didn't mean to offend, the ladies came out guns blazing prepared to prove that looking pretty is not a woman's main job in the big 2026. "Too busy hitting people," replied a woman in a boxer's uniform. "Because I'm tired, Jenny," a mom of two wrote, demonstrating that pretty nails are the last thing on some women's minds.

item.title: 87 Cool And Inspiring Before-And-Afters That Prove Any Space Can Be Saved With The Right Vision
item.description: A home makeover can change everything—not just how a space looks, but how it makes us feel. And since we spend so much of our time there, it’s only natural that the atmosphere can affect our mood. To show just how transformative a few updates can be, we’ve rounded up a collection of satisfying before-and-after renovation ideas from two X accounts. Take a look through these photos, you might walk away with inspiration for your own next project.

item.description: There’s something magical about spending time in your own backyard, but when your neighbor’s towering trees decide to greet you with a daily shower of leaves or vines, you might spend most of your weekends trimming hedges. item.title: 53 Memes That Are So Relatable You Might Feel Called Out (New Pics)
item.description: You can count on a meme to make you feel seen, then make you feel attacked right after. You will see one that gives you a sense of validation, then another that feels made for you. Check out these examples we’ve collected. Go ahead and see how many times you catch yourself saying, “Yep, I’ve been there.”

item.title: “Flipped His Desk”: 53 Coworkers Share The Fastest They Saw Their Colleagues Getting Fired
item.description: In some jobs, it doesn't take much to get the sack. One mistake and you might be out. But these folks could probably compete for some kind of record with their ability to get fired in the blink of an eye. If you're curious what they did to get fired in a couples of days, weeks, or, in some cases, on the same day they were hired, read these stories that people have shared about their own short-lived coworkers.
